tooltip.obscuras_storage.exporter: Moves matching items from the storage\into the inventory in front of it.\Back: cable, connector or inventory.\Front: the inventory to fill.\Place it against a cable or connector: the back plugs in.\Place it against a chest: the front faces it.\Filter slots: up to 9 items or filter items,\an empty filter moves nothing.\A redstone signal stops it.
tooltip.obscuras_storage.ejector: Drops matching items from the storage\into the world, like a dropper.\Back: cable, connector or inventory.\Front: where the items come out.\Place it against a cable or connector: the back plugs in.\Otherwise the front faces you, or a chest you click.\Filter slots: up to 9 items or filter items,\an empty filter drops nothing.\Only works while powered by redstone:\all the time or one batch per pulse.
tooltip.obscuras_storage.disposal: Destroys matching items from the storage, forever.\Back: cable, connector or inventory.\Place it against a cable or connector: the back plugs in.\Otherwise the front faces you, or a chest you click.\Filter slots: up to 9 items or filter items,\an empty filter destroys nothing.\Starts paused, a redstone signal stops it.\Counts what it destroyed. The count is lost\when the block is broken.

chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.hint.rescan: %s rescans/min is high; a hopper chain or other block updates next to the connector may be touching the network every tick
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.hint.rebuil: the member list changed %s times a minute; inventories keep appearing or disappearing (moving blocks, block breakers, chunk borders), and every open terminal regroups after each change
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.hint.over_c: inventories over the cap (doctorMaxInventories) are not part of the network: %s

chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.hint.sync: %s sync packets/s; items change constantly while players watch a terminal
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.hint.blackl: some inventories are blacklisted for the Inventory Connector; an Inventory Cable Connector facing one still connects it
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.hint.cables: the cable scan stopped at invConnectorMaxCables (%s); blocks further away are not connected
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.hint.slow: most of the time goes to checking every inventory for changes; fewer, larger inventories make the network cheaper
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.footnote: Counted: Inventory Connector checks (scans, rebuilds), cable connector checks, the change scan over all inventories, terminal list rebuilds and sync, and hoppers, level emitters, Ejectors, Disposals and Exporters working on this network. Not counted: player clicks in terminals, wireless terminals and Builder's Reach, item moves by other mods' pipes and hoppers, and work on other threads.

chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.block.netwo: A storage network block (connector, cable, terminal...): part of the network itself, not an inventory in it.
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.block.trim: A trim block: carries the Inventory Connector's scan to further inventories, holds no items.
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.block.skip_: In #obscuras_storage:inventory_connector_skip: the Inventory Connector never connects it.
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.block.confi: Listed in the blockedBlocks config: the Inventory Connector never connects it.
Its mod (%s) is listed in the blockedMods config: the Inventory Connector never connects it.
In #obscuras_storage:inventory_configurator_skip: the Inventory Configurator cannot configure it.
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.block.inven: Exposes an item inventory on every side (%s) through the %s.
Exposes an item inventory on these sides only: %s (%s). The Inventory Connector reads the side that touches the network.
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.block.no_in: No side exposes an item inventory through the %s: it cannot join a network.
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.block.conta: A vanilla container block: both loaders expose it as an item inventory.
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.block.block: Has a block entity; whether it exposes an inventory can only be checked on a placed block: use doctor block at <pos> or look at one.
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.block.no_bl: Has no block entity: usually not an inventory (a few blocks such as the composter still expose one). Check a placed one with doctor block at <pos>.
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.block.multi: Vanilla chest: both halves of a double chest are merged into one inventory.
Part of a multiblock: merged with %s other blocks into one inventory.
Multiblock inventory blocks configured (multiblockInv): %s (vanilla double chests always work).
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.block.filte: Excluded with the Inventory Configurator: no network uses it.
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.block.only_: onlyTrims is on: inventories do not pass the scan on, it has to touch the connector or a trim.
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.block.range: Joins when it touches an Inventory Connector, a connected inventory or a trim, up to %s blocks from the connector.
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.block.cable: An Inventory Cable Connector facing it connects it over any cable distance.
An Inventory Cable Connector facing it still connects it: the blacklist only applies to the Inventory Connector's scan.
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.block.not_i: Not part of any loaded network.

chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.verdict.cab: only through an Inventory Cable Connector
chat.obscuras_storage.doctor.summary: %s inventories · %s slots (%s full) · %s terminals · %s duplicates merged
Network Doctor: max inventories per network

At most this many inventories per storage network, the rest is skipped
and listed as "over cap" by /obscuras_storage doctor at
Value of 0 means no cap
Network Doctor: warn at ms per tick

Log a warning (at most once per network every 10 minutes) when a storage network
averages at least this many milliseconds per tick
Value of 0 disables the warning
Network Doctor: warn above inventories

Log a warning (at most once per network every 10 minutes) when a storage network
has more inventories than this
Value of 0 disables the warning
Tidy button

The terminal button that merges partial stacks
and moves stray items into their home inventory
Tidy: moves per tick
Stack moves per tick and network (1 to 64)

A run stops after this many seconds, planning included
The moves made until then stay
Tidy: cooldown seconds
Seconds after a run before the same network can be tidied again
Tidy: operators only
Only operators (permission level 2) may use the Tidy button
Tidy: include Shulker Docks

Also rearrange the contents of shulker boxes in Shulker Docks
